svg.title: A constant quadrature trim cannot remove a differential path delay
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: A constant quadrature trim cannot remove a differential path delay
Independent 10 mV single-tone fundamentals; 20 mV training at other frequencies
Desired phase relative to target plane delayed by 20 ns
Curves are single-tone fundamentals of the supplied cubic-path model, not full distortion tests.
f = 0 is the rotating-tone limit: coincident DC lines do not define a separate image ratio.
An overall timestamp shift cannot eliminate conjugate leakage from unequal I/Q delays.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
